combo_rules: For every reached combo, only the highest-probability action survives; a second action survives iff f>=40% and >=70% of the largest. Zero reach means no action. Never generalize exact-board certificates across textures or SPR.
warning: CERT is for exact original public board, pot, SPR and action history only. 392 generic MODEL boards are NOT certified or estimated.

nl2_pool_lock_coverage.interpretation: Regex match is source coverage, not observed combo evidence; unmatched villain nodes remain unlocked.
